title: Car dealership director's office room key

infobox.usage: Unlocks the director's office in the closed second floor section of the LexOs car dealership on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Car dealership director's office room key (LexOs) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the offices in the LexOs car dealership.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Your Car Needs a Service

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as initial equipment from Your Car Needs a Service

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Office in the closed second floor section of the LexOs car dealership at Streets of Tarkov. Requires a Car dealership closed section key to enter.
